doc: Focus, selection and scroll: imperative presentation mechanics a projection cannot express (LCP-007). The engine decides when and where focus moves; the pack only performs the move and reports what happened. Targets are named in HTML with data-focus-target, so no DOM node ever crosses the boundary.

types.name: FocusTarget
types.doc: An element named in HTML by data-focus-target="name". Inside a data-each row, key selects the row: the nearest ancestor carrying data-focus-key (projected by the engine with data-bind-data-focus-key) must equal it. generation, when given, must equal the nearest data-focus-generation ancestor attribute (also projected by the engine); a mismatch means the request was made for a screen that has since been replaced, and it is answered Stale rather than performed.

variants.name: blur
variants.doc: Remove focus from the target if it has it.

variants.name: focusFirst
variants.doc: Focus the first focusable element inside the target, in document order.

variants.name: focusLast
variants.doc: Focus the last focusable element inside the target, in document order.

variants.name: select
variants.doc: Focus a text control and select characters [start, end).

variants.name: selectAll
variants.doc: Focus a text control and select all of its text.

types.name: FocusResult
types.doc: Every outcome the engine must handle. None of them is retried or recovered by the pack.

variants.name: NotFound
variants.doc: No element in the current page has this target identity: a wrong name, or a row that no longer exists.

variants.name: Ambiguous
variants.doc: More than one element has this target identity; the pack will not guess.

variants.name: NotFocusable
variants.doc: The element exists but the browser would not focus it (disabled, hidden, inert, or not focusable), or a scope contains nothing focusable.

variants.name: NotSelectable
variants.doc: select or selectAll on an element without a text selection (a button, or an input type such as number or email).

variants.name: InvalidRange
variants.doc: start or end is negative, or start is after end.

variants.name: Stale
variants.doc: The target's generation no longer matches: the request was made for a screen that has been replaced.

variants.name: Unavailable
variants.doc: This browser does not implement the operation.
